title: 2x4 on the local emulator H2-1LE: infeasible (prompts/35 3.6)

data.sentence: at 20 qubits the emulator needs 51.9 s per shot for 2158 ZZ; the 2x4 k = 1 circuit has 32.3x the two-qubit gates on 2^8 = 256x the amplitudes, i.e. hours per shot, and the H2-1LE models a 20-qubit machine (devices_20261002.json specs.quantinuum_h1_1), which cannot hold 28
